title: os validate: a translation bundle's packages key that names no known manifest id passes silently, so a typo'd package name never shows
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Blocked-by: #37933

## Why this matters

#35513 (PR #37933) lets a translation bundle carry `packages: { MANIFEST_ID: { name, description } }`, so Setup › 软件包 and the Studio package switcher show a package's name in the user's language. A misspelt or stale key (a renamed package, a copy-pasted id from another app) matches nothing. Validation passes, the console shows `manifest.name` untranslated, and the author also gets the `i18n/missing-package` warning for the real id with no hint that the entry exists under a wrong key. They have to diff ids by hand. L1-b raised this on #37933 (ACCEPT 7220739710), and the PR report lists it as an open question.

## Acceptance

- `os validate` (and the same check wherever the stack's translation bundles are validated) reports a `packages` key that names no manifest id known to the stack. It names the key, the locale, and the closest known id when there is one.
- It is a warning, not an error, in line with `i18n/missing-package`. A stack whose keys all match sees no new output.
- Tests: a wrong key warns, a right key is silent, and a package-less stack is silent.

## Out of scope

Teaching the group in skills and docs is #37988.
